evidence: Touches test infrastructure in src/test/util/common.h and carries the Tests label, replacing Boost test macros with thread-safe custom assertion utilities.
rationale: Prevents silent test false-passes and ThreadSanitizer failures in unit and fuzz tests. Boost assertion macros silently allow invalid mixed-signedness checks like `BOOST_CHECK_GT(-10, 10U)` to pass, fail under TSan when invoked on background threads, and cannot be reused in fuzz test harnesses (description, #34666). While valuable for test correctness and harness unification, resolving test macro limitations is reasonably deferrable.
